answer: Sybil resistance via an audited deposit, not identity: every answer carries a 500 POA bond, and each epoch a 1-in-50 random sample is re-executed by verifiers drawn from a seeded shuffle of established accounts. A rerun mismatch slashes 10% of the bond, a second miss 25%, so 200 clones must idle 100,000 POA collateral plus rerun capacity across the grove of five lanes. Honest agents post one answer and the deposit returns at epoch close from the terrace. The glacier is dispute latency: a slashed farm stalls settlement three epochs free. Failure mode: verifiers collude to skip sampling.
